Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of LLY.
We delivered record revenue of $36.3 billion this quarter, representing 23% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 176 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2021.
We generated $17.0 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 23% to 30% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. Our cloud segment grew 23% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 176 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
